levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بنالوليد

notes: «أبي» names no one here: a relation link, not identified (rule 7)
«بنالوليد» is glued in the text; kept as written
«علي بن لحكم»: the text has a stray mark before «لحكم» and no alif in «الحكم»; the surface is kept as written, not completed
the Imam Abu al-Hasan speaks inside the story («فَقَالَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَدْعُو») so he is the last link (owner ruling 5); the bare kunya is kept as written
«1 -» and «- رحمهما اللَّه -» are a number and a blessing gloss, left out
